description: This file defines a static utility class 'StorageEmulator' providing methods to manage and interact with the Azure Storage Emulator, including starting, stopping, checking if it is running, and retrieving help information.

classes.name: StorageEmulator
classes.description: A static class providing a wrapper and utility functions for managing the Azure Storage Emulator.

methods.name: IsStarted
methods.description: Checks if the storage emulator process is currently running.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Determines if the storage emulator is installed by checking its executable path.

methods.name: Help
methods.description: Retrieves help information from the running storage emulator process.

methods.name: TryStart
methods.description: Attempts to start the storage emulator if it exists.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the storage emulator process if it is not already running.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the storage emulator process if it is currently running.

methods.name: CreateProcessArguments
methods.description: Creates a ProcessStartInfo object configured to run storage emulator commands.

methods.name: GetStorageEmulatorProcess
methods.description: Checks for existing storage emulator processes by process name.

methods.name: GetStorageEmulatorPath
methods.description: Locates the installation path of the storage emulator executable.

methods.name: GetProgramFilesBasePath
methods.description: Returns the base Program Files directory path depending on OS architecture.
